recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If maintainers later regenerate OperationDefinition diagrams or decide checked-in SVG tooltips are in reconciliation scope, handle that as generated-artifact refresh work rather than as a FHIR-39345 source correction.
issue_request: FHIR-39345 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to fix the OperationDefinition.parameter.targetProfile short display typo 'allowed reosurce types' and to adjust invariant opd-3 so targetProfile can be specified for parameters of type Reference, canonical, or a resource.
initial_application: Git commit 116ec0f74df0b1d99395400acd7ba97688c56103 applied the seed request by updating source/operationdefinition/structuredefinition-OperationDefinition.xml to include resource parameters in opd-3 and by fixing the targetProfile short display typo. That original application used the then-requested ValueSet/resource-types expression.
additional_context: FHIR-26411 is the supporting R5 decision that OperationDefinition.parameter.targetProfile applies to inline resources. FHIR-44690 later found that FHIR-39345's ValueSet/resource-types expression was too narrow by the time R5 finalized and corrected opd-3 to ValueSet/all-resource-types; a later reconciliation commit clarified the targetProfile definition for resource parameter types. OperationDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini. The only old targetProfile prose found for this issue family is in source/operationdefinition/operationdefinition.svg, a generated-looking diagram artifact, while the authoritative StructureDefinition XML carries the current rule.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative OperationDefinition StructureDefinition already allows targetProfile for Reference, canonical, and resource parameter types, uses the later all-resource-types correction, and has the typo and definition gaps resolved. Editing only the stale SVG tooltip would not be an authoritative source fix and is outside the generated-diagram guardrail.

related_jiras.note: Established that OperationDefinition.parameter.targetProfile should apply to inline resource parameters.
